how_to_run: Run each prompt with the skill and without it in fresh sessions. Do not allow the eval to create real panes or worktrees: stop after the proposed approval manifest. Grade the transcript for repository inspection, grouping logic, explicit launch approval, safe isolation and correct routing to neighbouring skills.
notes: The originating baseline used raw tmux keystrokes, left agent names unset, shared one checkout without stating why it was safe, and mistook prompts visible in several composers for submitted work. Those observed failures are the behavioural target.

evals.name: messy-mixed-planning-fanout
evals.prompt: got this handoff in /tmp/review.md with like 14 things. can you sanity check them, bunch related ones together, then spin up claude or codex in named tmux windows for each group? plan mode, max 5, and make every one grill me before it settles the plan
assertions: Reads the task source and relevant repository before proposing groups
Produces dependency-aware groups rather than one pane per raw bullet
Applies plan mode and grilling to every proposed assignment
Shows provider, names, checkout, dependencies and prompts in an approval manifest
Does not create panes before explicit approval
evals.history: Generalises the wedding audit workflow without baking audits into the skill.

evals.name: dirty-dependent-implementation-batch
evals.prompt: split these six accepted fixes across cxy agents and have them implement now. two depend on the schema change and my checkout has edits I haven't committed yet. use whatever worktrees thing I have
assertions: Inspects Git status and the task dependencies
Blocks implementation fan-out because the approved base is dirty
Does not stash, copy the dirty patch or place concurrent editors in one checkout
Places schema dependants in later waves
Explains that explicit cxy selects bypass permissions without treating it as the default
evals.history: Protects the implementation boundary that was safe but implicit in the originating read-only run.

evals.name: existing-agent-near-miss
evals.prompt: is the agent in the api-fix pane done yet? when it finishes tell it to run the integration tests
assertions: Routes to coding-agents instead of dispatching-agent-panes
Does not create a manifest, pane, window or worktree
Uses the existing agent name for waiting and prompting
evals.history: Near-miss boundary: controlling existing agents belongs to coding-agents.
